title: Brand tracking: how to track brand health and explain what moves it
summary: Brand tracking shows a metric moved, not why. Get the framework for pairing tracker waves with qualitative diagnosis before the decision closes.
body_markdown:
What do brand tracking companies offer? +


Brand tracking companies mostly offer syndicated brand health trackers, custom market research, or self-serve brand tracking tools. Syndicated trackers provide daily benchmarks and historical trends, but fixed questions and competitive sets limit diagnosis. Custom brand tracking studies add tailored depth, though qualitative follow-up typically takes weeks to commission and field. Teams that need the reason inside the same window can add Conveo StoryLines alongside an existing tracker as an AI-moderated diagnostic layer.


What is a brand tracking example? +


A typical brand tracking example looks like this representative one: a brand tracker survey shows unaided recall slipping among new customers in one market after a competitor launch, with no explanation attached. The team fields AI-moderated interviews in that market only and finds participants now link the category's main benefit to the competitor. The brand adjusts its local messaging before the next wave reads the impact.


Is there a brand tracking app? +


Most brand tracking app searches come from teams that want continuous brand understanding, and a mobile dashboard alone rarely delivers it. Conversation about a brand online can turn within days, and an annual wave may not register the shift until marketing efforts have moved on. Asynchronous fieldwork runs interviews in parallel across markets and time zones. With Conveo StoryLines, teams run AI-moderated video conversations with real consumers in recurring waves, so each reading arrives with its reason.


How often should brand tracking run? +


Cadence should match how fast perception moves in the category and how often the metrics feed a real decision, such as a new marketing campaign or a pricing change. Annual or biannual waves leave a reading that can be six months behind a competitor launch. Tracking your brand quarterly suits most teams that track brand awareness and consideration, with interviews fielded on the same schedule so a flagged movement gets investigated in the wave it appears. Conveo StoryLines waves can run more often, for example every two weeks or monthly, for teams whose decisions turn over faster than the tracker does.


What is the difference between brand tracking and brand health research? +


Brand tracking is the measurement instrument: the same awareness, consideration, favorability, brand satisfaction, and purchase intent questions asked of a consistent competitive set, wave after wave, so movement is comparable. Brand health research is the wider body of work that interprets those brand health metrics, including \[brand equity research\](/insights/brand-equity-research-methods-measure-brand-value), positioning, brand associations, competitive analysis, and driver studies that explain what sits behind a shift in brand equity. The tracker tells a team the score changed, and the research explains what changed it, so measuring brand health takes both. Pairing the two on one cadence is what keeps the explanation inside the decision window.
